content.text: Every NPC gets skin overlays the first time you meet them, and keeps them: chosen for who they are. Raiders are inked, scarred and grimy; settlers mostly plain, with a mole or a small tattoo; the Brotherhood clean but for a scar and its own mark; the Institute almost untouched. Everyone gets the everyday layer: moles, body hair, skin detail. Never more than six overlays on anyone, never three of a kind, and a faction's emblem only on its own people.

content.help: Off: nobody new gets overlays from Complexion. People who already have theirs keep them.

Slave stamps and barcodes, chains, a collar's chafe, sexual tattoos, bites and hickeys, words in marker: on raiders' captives, and on raiders and the Nuka-World gangs at low odds; and with Rapport, the lewd marks of NPCs whose Rapport persona is vulgar ("ENTRY" with an arrow, "Back Door", "SLUT", lipstick kisses...). Off: nobody gets any of them. Takes effect for people met from now on (Roll everyone again to change everyone).

content.text: Choose overlays by hand: aim at someone (or no one, for yourself) and open the window. They stand still, undressed, framed by the camera; click an overlay to put it on or take it off, live. Apply keeps it - their look from then on; Cancel puts back what they had. Pictures for Complexion's own overlays; other packs' show by name.
Open the window on the NPC in your sights, or on you
content.help: Opens the overlay window on the NPC you aim at (or aimed at in the last seconds), or on you. Pressed again while it is open, it closes it as Cancel.

content.text: Open the window on the NPC I aimed at
content.help: Opens the overlay window on whoever was in your sights in the half minute before you opened this menu, when you close it.
Opens the overlay window on you, when you close this menu. Complexion never gives you a random look: this is how you choose yours.
Forgets every look Complexion gave and decides everyone anew as you meet them. Their old Complexion overlays are replaced; overlays other mods put on them are kept.

For moving from Random Overlay Framework: LooksMenu forgets every overlay on everyone, ROF's leftovers included (and any you set by hand on NPCs). Complexion then puts its own looks back as you meet people. Do it outside of any AAF scene, then save and load.

content.text: What do the people around me wear?
content.help: Every overlay LooksMenu holds on each person within about 20 metres, Complexion's marked, and what Complexion decided for them, written to Complexion.log (Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE).
